description: An awareness episode of about 8 minutes for executive assistants and PAs, on the inbox side only. Sit in the PA's seat at Merrin & Sallow Architects, a fictional practice, while the managing partner travels: five emails and voicemails, some real and some made to trick you, one in a copied voice. Each answer is explained, and reporting or checking when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down.
